Definition
[Admissible pair, Lax entropy condition] ↗ def:shock-set ↗ thm:structure-of-shock-set 1. ch11:11.2-def-4\group Conservation Laws

Assume the pair $(\lambda _k, r_k)$ is genuinely nonlinear at $u_l$. We say that the pair $(u_l, u_r)$ is admissible provided \[ u_r \in S_k(u_l) \] and \[ (42) \qquad \lambda _k(u_r) < \sigma (u_r,u_l) < \lambda _k(u_l). \] Condition (42) is the Lax entropy condition; the displayed discontinuous solution is then a $k$-shock wave.
